nodes.label: Phase 7 Thin-Client Cloud Server Plan
nodes.description: Planned web/mobile architecture places simulation, inference, and persistence in an Axum WebSocket server while browser and mobile clients render shared UI state.

nodes.label: Egui-Everywhere Client Strategy
nodes.description: The plan proposes shared egui panels compiled to WASM for browsers and wrapped by Tauri v2 for iOS and Android, populated from a common serialized protocol.

nodes.label: Remote Session Lifecycle and Observability
nodes.description: Anonymous token-based sessions persist on disconnect, reconnect over WebSocket, expire after inactivity, and are bounded by rate limits, metrics, health checks, and configurable capacity.

edges.description: Shared egui rendering is the client half of the proposed thin-client architecture.
Session management, monitoring, and rate limits operationalize remote hosting.
